scope: Actual dedicated control-plane PostgreSQL deployment scaled to zero and restored. Thirty-two requests across four distinct gateway pods, bounded client deadline 15s.
diagnosis: Fixture used emptyDir: scaling PostgreSQL to zero erased its test database. Outage returned expected 503 limit_store_unavailable, but recovery was 500 UndefinedTable. A new PVC-backed fixture is required; this is not a passing recovery gate and no historical database rows were restored.
